name: Xero Food Mart
summary: A convenience store chain with 17 branches that sells Zombix, pet food and groceries.
body: PowerPyx lists 17 Xero Food Mart branches among Leonida's 72 convenience stores: Southwind, Grassrivers (two), Capri, Southside, Tequesta, Salton, Crosstown, Rockridge, La Perle, Belville, Waning Sands, Buckskin Swamp (two), South Kelly County, Ambrosia and Millport.

PowerPyx says convenience stores sell the healing item Zombix, pet food for domestic animals and groceries for the fridge at home, and are marked with a blue shopping bag icon once the map is unfogged.
PowerPyx's 100% checklist counts convenience, fast food and liquor stores together as Stick Up targets (50 of 91 needed).
